title: API Registry (api registry list/add/show/remove)
description: Implement a local JSON catalogue of named Cliq API endpoints. The registry.json format must be compatible with the existing CliqApiMcp registry format to ease migration.
prerequisiteState: All v1 stories complete. ApiClient and api call command working.
goal: api registry add/list/show/remove correctly persists and retrieves endpoint entries in registry.json. Format is backward-compatible with CliqApiMcp.
scope: Create src/CliqCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistryEntry.cs sealed record: string Id, string Method, string UrlTemplate, string Purpose
Create src/CliqCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistryRoot.cs sealed record: List<ApiRegistryEntry> Apis
Create src/CliqCli.Core/Api/IApiRegistry.cs with LoadAsync, SaveAsync, FindAsync(id), UpsertAsync(entry), RemoveAsync(id), ListAsync

Create src/CliqCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistry.cs implementing IApiRegistry — persists to <configDir>/registry.json using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower; json key for Apis is 'apis'; id lookup is case-insensitive; UpsertAsync overwrites existing entry with same id
Create src/CliqCli/Commands/ApiRegistryCommands.cs with RegistryListCommand, RegistryAddCommand, RegistryShowCommand, RegistryRemoveCommand
RegistryAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: upsert entry, return success with the entry
RegistryShowSettings: --id (req); return entry or REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND exit 1
RegistryRemoveSettings: --id (req); remove entry or REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND exit 1
Register all four commands under 'api registry' branch in Program.cs
Unit tests: add entry, list returns it, show returns it, remove deletes it; show/remove of missing id → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; upsert overwrites existing entry
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
api registry add --id list-channels --method GET --url-template /api/v2/channels --purpose 'List channels' returns success with the entry
api registry list returns the entry
api registry show --id list-channels returns the entry
api registry show --id nonexistent → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, exit 1
api registry remove --id list-channels removes it; subsequent show → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND
registry.json uses key 'apis' and snake_case — compatible with CliqApiMcp registry format
contextForAgent: Read tech_spec §4 api registry subcommands. Read CliqApiMcp registry.json format from Downloads/CliqApiMcp if accessible — the key is 'apis', entries have 'id', 'method', 'urlTemplate', 'purpose'. Use camelCase for urlTemplate in registry.json (not snake_case) to match CliqApiMcp format — this is an exception to the general SnakeCaseLower rule. Confirm by checking the actual CliqApiMcp source if available.

openItems.defaultAssumption: Use 'urlTemplate' (camelCase) in registry.json to match CliqApiMcp format, despite the general SnakeCaseLower policy. Apply a JsonPropertyName attribute on UrlTemplate to override the naming policy for this specific field.
